title: Thousands of Fancy Dishes Have Survived a 2,100-Year-Old Shipwreck - Nautilus
author: David Nield
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHistoryThousands of Fancy Dishes Have Survived a 2,100-Year-Old ShipwreckYou probably wouldn’t want to eat off them thoughDNBy David Nield9:00 AM CDT on October 6, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleAfter spending 2,100 years at the bottom of the Mediterranean, you’d expect ship cargo to have decayed beyond recognition. But that’s not the case with the expensive freight of a wrecked boat recovered by a team from Akdeniz University in Türkiye.Powered By 10 ShareNextStayTo date, the haul includes 6,511 ceramic plates, bowls, and trays, in a total of 122 different forms and sizes. The pieces have now been transferred to the Antalya Museum, about 55 miles from the village of Adrasan, where the dishes were discovered.Some 6,511 items have now been brought to the surface.
